decisions.reason: Although healthcare and hospitality recruitment is distant from the core maritime offer and its fit is uncertain, the firm is growing and has slack, and it can reuse its recruitment infrastructure, so management will likely carry it for now rather than launch problemistic search after only one year.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer pool, so it carries low incremental cost and likely meets aspirations, which makes dropping it unlikely.
